title: Vehicle Inspection Form
description: A pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspection form for fleet operators and drivers. Drivers record the vehicle, odometer, and fuel level, mark exterior, tire, under-hood, and interior safety items as OK, Defect, or N/A, log tire pressures, and describe any defects with severity and photos. A defect section appears automatically when any item fails, and the driver signs off on whether the vehicle is safe to operate.
